description: This PHP source file defines the class ProjectViewTemplatesDetail, which extends ViewDetail. The class manages the display of detailed views for project templates within the SuiteCRM system, including rendering module titles, retrieving project records, and displaying associated subpanels.

classes.name: ProjectViewTemplatesDetail
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail that manages the display of project template detail views in SuiteCRM. Handles rendering module titles and subpanels.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the parameters for the module title, including a link to edit the project.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Loads the project bean and assigns display variables, including ownership-based permissions, then calls parent display method.

methods.name: _displaySubPanels
methods.description: Loads and displays the subpanels related to the project templates.
